title: Winter Wedding Skincare: A Simple Guide for Couples and Guests
ex: Winter wedding skincare for couples and guests: moisturise against dry air, keep sunscreen for daytime functions and avoid new products in the last two weeks.
rt: Winter Wedding Skincare for Couples and Guests | Mirc Glow
rd: Winter wedding skincare for couples and guests in India: a simple timeline, daily routine, make-up prep tips and what to avoid in the final two weeks.
quick: For a winter wedding, moisturise on damp skin morning and night, wear SPF 30 at daytime functions, remove make-up fully every night and use a rich night cream. Couples should start 8–12 weeks ahead and stop new products two weeks before.
facts: Dry winter air makes skin lose water faster
Sunscreen is still needed at daytime functions
Avoid new products and peels in the last two weeks
Make-up sits better on well-moisturised skin
